name: Nexen Corporation
summary: Nexen Corporation manufactures and sells rubber products in South Korea. The company offers tubes and flaps, solid tires, golf balls, and bladders for tires, and carbon masterbatch related products. It provides logistics services comprising of sea, bulk, air, inland transport and distribution, warehouse, and knock down. The company exports and distributes its products to approximately 140 countries. Nexen Corporation was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Gimhae-si, South Korea.
